title: The fixed ordinary open-image comparison respects the unit
statement: For a scheme morphism h:X→Y, an open U of Y and an O_X-module M, let F=h_*. Assemble D_U: (j_{h⁻¹U,*} restriction) followed by F ≅ F followed by (j_{U,*} restriction) from the underived composition and restriction comparisons [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model], using associators. Then F(η_{h⁻¹U,M});D_U(M)=η_{U,F(M)}, where the units and open-image functors are [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data].

source.place: Tags 08FE, underived identity in the proof, and 08BV, displayed section sequence; official Stacks pages read online

proof.text: Apply the generic adjunction Hom equivalence, naturality of the counit, and the triangle identities to the existing homotopy counit square to obtain its unit square. Represent the ordinary module M by its single-term complex in degree zero. Rewrite the mapped homotopy adjunction units and comparison maps using their quotient formulas. The resulting equality is equality of the quotient images of two actual chain maps. Extract a homotopy and evaluate its degree-zero equation: both differentials vanish, so the chain-map components are equal. Expanding only the formal associators and whiskerings of the ordinary comparison identifies this equality with the desired unit identity. No sectionwise mate expansion, derived category, injectivity, cover or boundedness hypothesis is used.

proof_origin.note: Proved in Lean from the existing homotopy counit square, generic adjunction identities, and the degree-zero equation of a homotopy between zero-differential complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison_unit
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).map
        ((schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U)).unit.app M) ≫
        (schemeOpenImageDirectImageComparison h U).hom.app M =
      (schemeOpenModuleAdjunction Y U).unit.app
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj M)
